 The Union Public Service Commission has released the UPSC IAS Main result 2026 on November 5, 2026 on the official website at upsonline.nic.in/upsc.gov.in. The UPSC IAS Main exam 2026 was held between August 21 to 23, and 29 to 30, 2026. The commission released the UPSC IAS admit card 2026 on August 14, 2026. Earlier, the commission activated the UPSC IAS 2026 DAF application form from June 19 to 29, 2026, on the official website.

 UPSC Civil Services 2026
 Earlier, the commission declared the UPSC CSE Prelims result 2026 on June 15, 2026. The provisional UPSC Prelims 2026 answer key was released on May 27, 2026. The commission successfully conducted the UPSC CSE exam 2026 Prelims on May 24, 2026, in offline mode. The UPSC CSE 2026 prelims admit card was issued on May 15, 2026.
 The UPSC CSE 2026 application correction window was activated from February 28 to March 3, 2026. Candidates were able to fill out the UPSC CSE application form 2026 from February 4 to 27, 2026. The UPSC Civil Service exam is conducted every year. The UPSC CSE 2026 notification was released on February 4, 2026. The UPSC Civil Services exam is conducted to recruit potential civil servants for the Government of India.
 The UPSC Civil Services exam is one of the toughest in India, with lakhs of candidates applying every year. With determination and consistent preparation, candidates can clear the UPSC CSE exam 2026. The articles below give all the basic details related to the UPSC Civil Services exam 2026 –

 The UPSC Civil Services notification 2026 was released by the commission on February 4, 2026, on the official website. The UPSC Civil Services notification date was announced through the UPSC Annual Calendar. The UPSC CSE 2026 notification contains all the essential information related to the examination, like the eligibility, vacancies, steps to submit the application form, etc.
 UPSC Civil Services Application Form 2026
 The UPSC CSE 2026 DAF was released on June 19, 2026, on the official website. Candidates are required to submit the UPSC Civil Services 2026 application form by the last date, which is June 29, 2026. Before filling the application form, candidates have to complete the UPSC Civil Services registration. All the information and documents related to the candidate must be entered correctly.
 UPSC Civil Services 2026 Eligibility Criteria
 Candidates who are interested in applying for the exam must meet the UPSC Civil Services 2026 eligibility criteria. The eligibility criteria are the essential requirements which a candidate must possess to succeed in the exam. The UPSC Civil Service eligibility 2026 includes nationality, age limit, minimum educational qualification and the number of attempts. The UPSC CSE eligibility criteria is as follows -
 Nationality –  The candidate must be an Indian citizen.
 Age limit –  The candidate must be between 21 and 32 years.
 Educational qualification - Candidates must hold a graduate degree.
 Number of attempts –  General – 6 attempts
 OBC/PwBD ( for GL/EWS/OBC) - 9
 SC/ST - Unlimited

 UPSC Civil Services 2026 Syllabus
 The UPSC CSE syllabus is specified in the official notification. The detailed UPSC Civil Services 2026 syllabus of both the prelims and mains is available. Before starting the preparation, aspirants are recommended to go through the UPSC CSE syllabus 2026 and the exam pattern.
 UPSC Civil Services 2026 Selection Process
 The UPSC CSE selection process 2026 is given in the official notification. After each stage of the UPSC Civil Services 2026 selection process, a certain percentage of the candidates fail to proceed to the next stage. Candidates are selected based on their qualifying percentage, performance and the cut off marks. The UPSC Civil Services selection process includes the following stages -
 Preliminary stage.
 Mains stage.
 Personality interview.
 UPSC Civil Services 2026 Exam Centres
 Candidates have to choose their desired UPSC CSE exam centre 2026 while filling out the application form. Candidates are given the option to choose at least 3 UPSC Civil Services 2026 exam centres while filling the prelims application form. The choice of the UPSC CSE mains exam centre may vary. There are a total of 80 UPSC Civil Services prelims exam centres and 24 exam centres for the Mains exam.
 UPSC Civil Services 2026 Admit Card
 The commission issued the UPSC CSE prelims admit card on May 15, 2026. The UPSC CSE admit card is like an entry pass to appear in the examination. The UPSC CSE 2026 admit card is released at least 7 to 10 days before the exam date. Candidates are advised to download the UPSC Civil Services admit card 2026 well in advance. Along with the admit card, a valid photocopy also needs to be carried.
 UPSC Civil Services 2026 Answer Key
 The commission released the provisional UPSC CSE answer key 2026 on the official website. The final UPSC Civil Services 2026 answer key will be released after the completion of all the stages of the examination. The UPSC Civil Services answer key is released for the candidates to know the correct answers. The commission does not provide an answer key or objection facility.
 UPSC Civil Services 2026 Result
 The UPSC CSE result 2026 has been released on November 5, 2026, on the official website. The UPSC Civil Services 2026 result has been released in PDF format. The UPSC Civil Services prelims result will take a month or more to be released. The steps to check the UPSC Civil Services results 2026 are -
 Go to the official website, upsc.gov.in.
 On the homepage, there will be a result section, or candidates can click on ‘Examinations’ and click on ‘Active examination’.
 Click on the exam you were looking for.
 Click on it and click on the ‘result PDF’.
 Search for the roll number by using ‘Ctrl + F’.
 UPSC Civil Services 2026 Cut Off
 The UPSC CSE cut off 2026 will be released after the conclusion of the entire selection process. The UPSC Civil Services cut of marks will be released for all the stages of the exam at once. The UPSC Civil Services 2026 cut off marks are the minimum marks which a candidate must attain to clear the exam. The UPSC Civil Services cut off varies by category.
 UPSC Civil Services 2026 Question Paper
 The commission will release the UPSC Civil Services question paper 2026 on the official website. The UPSC CSE 2026 question paper will be released a few weeks after the completion of the exam. Candidates will also be able to find the UPSC CSE previous year question paper for practice. Practising at least the past 10 UPSC CSE previous year question papers is good enough to clear the exam.
 Steps to check the question papers -  
 Go to the official website, upsc.gov.in.
 On the homepage, click on ‘Examinations’.
 Under that, click on Previous Question papers’
 All the UPSC Civil Services subjects and papers will be available.
 UPSC Civil Services 2026 Vacancy
 A total of 933 UPSC IAS vacancies have been released by the commission. Candidates can check the UPSC Civil Services vacancies 2026 in the official notification. However, the UPSC CSE final vacancies might vary and are announced after the completion of the examination. The UPSC Civil Services vacancies 2026 vary by category. Candidates can understand the level of the competition by referring to the UPSC Civil Services 2026 vacancies.
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
 Q: Who is eligible for the UPSC exam 2026? A: Those who have a graduate degree and are between the age 21 - 32 are eligible to apply for the UPSC Civil Services exam.
 Q: What is the UPSC CSE notification date? A: The UPSC Civil Services 2026 notification date was February 4, 2026.
 Q: When will the UPSC Civil Services exam be conducted? A: The UPSC CSE prelims exam date 2026 is May 24, 2026. 
 Q: Is 27 too late for UPSC Civil Services? A: No, those who are 27 are eligible to apply and succeed in the UPSC Civil Services examination.
 Q: What is the UPSC Civil Services salary 2026? A: The UPSC CSE salary is in accordance with the 7th pay commission. The salary may be around Rs 56,100.
